verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Sprinto as a hosted platform for cloud-hosted companies and documents no self-hosted or on-prem deployment. The open-source compliance-skills repo is a set of agent skills, not the core product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
